w: Sector Los Angeles, Submerged Land Act (SLA)
d: Alcatel Submarine Networks Marine will conduct submarine telecommunications cable installation activities for Segment 6 of the ORCA Project from Hermosa Beach, California, to the offshore end of Segment 6 from August 24 through October 16, 2026. Operations will include route clearance, shore-end cable landing, cable burial, surface cable laying, and ROV operations along the cable route between 33.871435, -118.418618 and 37.387200, -128.266290. The C/S Ile de Sein will be engaged in these operations and will maintain a continuous listening watch on VHF-FM Channel 16. The vessel may be restricted in its ability to maneuver during certain phases of the work. For more information, contact the Master of C/S Ile de Sein at +47 23 67 48 00 or Luc Parkinson at +33 6 48 93 46 48. Mariners should be aware of possible short-term degradation to Global Positioning System (GPS) information. This degradation may occur while operating in and around Daggett, CA. The testing will be centered at approximately 35.36278, -116.53917, with potential impacts extending out to range of 50 ft above ground level with 133 nautical miles distance.

The testing is scheduled for the following dates and times (Pacific Daylight Time):

October 20, 2026: 9:30 a.m. – 3:29 p.m.

October 21, 2026: 9:30 a.m. – 12:59 p.m.

October 23, 2026: 9:30 a.m. – 12:59 p.m.

October 24 - 31, 2026: 11:00 p.m. (previous day) – 5:59 a.m. &amp; 9:30 a.m. – 3:29 p.m.

November 1, 2026: 12:00 a.m. – 6:59 a.m. &amp; 10:00 a.m. – 3:29 p.m.

In the unlikely event that mariners experience an anomaly with GPS or AIS, mariners are advised to notify their local Coast Guard Sector Command Center immediately.

A long-distance open-water swim will be conducted in the Pacific Ocean along the California coast from San Luis Obispo County to the Orange/San Diego County line from September 2026 to December 2026. The swim will occur periodically, as weather and sea conditions permit.

The swimmer will be accompanied by a designated support vessel that will remain in the immediate vicinity.

For more details or comments, mariners may monitor the live tracker at https://zerosixzero.com/catherinebreed/swim-california. All mariners are advised to transit the area with caution.
